resources.string: PHASE 03 // SHELL, LOCAL CAPTURE & LIVE HANDSHAKE

Phase 03 configures one GeminiLiveConnectionAdapter over Firebase AI Logic (gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview, v1beta) with App Check and redacted diagnostics. Voice-turn audio playback, call routing, and accessibility services remain deferred per PROJECT_CONTRACT.md.
Audio playback is not claimed in Phase 03. Verify Gemini Live handshake in Live Diagnostics or local PCM capture in Microphone Setup.
Open Microphone Setup and Self-Test Screen
Open Gemini Live Connection and Diagnostics Screen
Stop conversation session and release hardware immediately

OmniVoice Rebuild needs microphone access to capture 16,000 Hz 16-bit mono PCM audio frames for local hardware verification and future voice turns. In Phase 02–03, self-test audio never leaves the device, retention is off, and any temporary self-test playback clip is deleted immediately after verification or Stop.
HONESTY BOUNDARY: Microphone self-test verifies local acoustic capture & intelligible playback only. It is NOT an assistant answer; audio playback is not claimed in Phase 03.
